_comment: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 served by the SAME Kubernetes vLLM deployment as stage 1 (src/stage1_sampling/deployment_vllm_qwen.yaml + service_vllm_nodeport.yaml, applied from the gitignored .local.yaml copies). Endpoint and key are read from the environment so cluster node IPs / ports / secrets never enter tracked files: set QWEN_BASE_URL=http://<node-ip>:<nodePort>/v1 and QWEN_API_KEY=<the qwen-vllm-api-key secret value> (see .env.example). Sampling: temperature 0.7 / top_p 0.8 are Qwen3's recommended non-thinking settings (survey simulation needs respondent variance; stage 1 uses 0.1 because its task is deterministic extraction). chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false suppresses the chain of thought (drop that override if the served chat template rejects it -- the stage-4 parser now tolerates reasoning text before the answer either way). max_tokens 5000: the served --max-model-len is 16384 and full-length persona battery prompts run 8-11k tokens; observed battery outputs are ~3.2k tokens (brief explanations), so 5000 leaves headroom while never exceeding the window. If a prompt is still too long the client shrinks max_tokens to fit automatically (model_clients.py).
